parameters.query: INSERT INTO marketvoice_warehouse.human_review_case (case_id, idempotency_key, source_id, product_id, issue_name, priority_score, tier_code, reason_codes, review_status) VALUES ('CASE_{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.idempotency_key.substring(0,16).toUpperCase() }}', '{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.idempotency_key }}', '{{ $json.source_id }}', '{{ $json.entity_id }}', '{{ $json.issue_name }}', {{ $json.priority_score }}, '{{ $json.priority_tier_code }}', ARRAY[{{ $json.reason_codes.map(r => "'" + r + "'").join(',') }}]::text[], 'PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW') ON CONFLICT (case_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO marketvoice_warehouse.operational_event_log (idempotency_key, request_id, source_id, source_review_id, payload_hash, rating_value, detected_issues_count, priority_score, tier_code, routing_destination, is_duplicate, raw_payload, api_response) VALUES ('{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.idempotency_key }}', '{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.request_id }}', '{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.source_id }}', '{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.review_id }}', '{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.payload_hash }}', {{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.rating }}, 1, {{ $('FastAPI Decision Evaluate').item.json.priority_score }}, '{{ $('FastAPI Decision Evaluate').item.json.priority_tier_code }}', '{{ $('FastAPI Decision Evaluate').item.json.priority_tier_code.startsWith('P1') || $('FastAPI Decision Evaluate').item.json.priority_tier_code.startsWith('P2') ? 'HUMAN_REVIEW_QUEUE' : 'MONITORING_LOG' }}', false, '{{ JSON.stringify($('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json) }}'::jsonb, '{{ JSON.stringify($('FastAPI Decision Evaluate').item.json) }}'::jsonb);

INSERT INTO marketvoice_warehouse.workflow_execution (workflow_id, execution_id, idempotency_key, execution_status, retry_count, api_latency_ms, total_execution_ms) VALUES ('marketvoice_review_triage', 'EXEC_{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.idempotency_key.substring(0,12) }}_{{ Date.now() }}', '{{ $('Compute Idempotency Key').item.json.idempotency_key }}', 'SUCCESS', 0, 45, 120);
